title: Minimum Power-of-Two Operations to Zero
description: You are given a positive integer `n`. In one operation, you may add or subtract any power of two (`2^i` for any integer `i >= 0`) to or from `n`. Return the minimum number of operations required to reduce `n` to `0`.
hints: Inspect the lowest set bit `low = n & -n` using two's complement.

If the next bit `(low << 1)` is also set (a run of two or more consecutive `1`s), adding `low` collapses the entire run into a single higher bit; otherwise subtracting `low` eliminates that isolated bit.

examples.explanation: 16 is already a power of two, so 16 - 16 = 0 takes 1 operation.
